analyst: Hannah Clapham and Alex R. Cook
statement: A large local outbreak becomes unavoidable if tracing fails, and immunity from infection or vaccination ends transmission.
later_record: MOH moved Singapore to an endemic norm after later waves and cited population hybrid immunity.
evidence_basis: The later record documents the forecast's two material conditions: later waves and population immunity.
limitation: This is a conditional epidemiological forecast, not a judgement of government quality.

statement: Income volatility needs a new sharing of employment risk, including temporary income support while job seekers reskill or re-enter work.
later_record: SkillsFuture Jobseeker Support starts in April 2025 with temporary payments up to S$6,000 over six months.
evidence_basis: The later policy includes temporary income support during job search.
limitation: The programme is means-tested temporary support, not the universal or insurance model considered.

statement: COVID governance would heighten surveillance and create privacy and trust problems.
later_record: The Government confirmed police access to TraceTogether data, then passed a serious-offence limit.
evidence_basis: The legal record documents the privacy and trust issue raised by the analysis.
limitation: This is a team analysis. The legal event does not establish the overall effect on privacy or trust.

statement: Recovery should accelerate remote and contactless work, reskilling, and regional diversification.
later_record: IMDA reports that the digital economy rose from 14.9% of GDP in 2019 to 18.6% in 2024.
evidence_basis: The official aggregate measures a digital-economy trend that fits one part of the proposal.
limitation: The aggregate does not establish COVID as the cause or test every part of the recommendation.
